trend.title: M&T Bank's Credit-Loss Provision Rises to $135M in Q3 2026 as Commercial Credit Costs Climb
trend.scope: M&T Bank Corporation (NYSE: MTB), a Buffalo-based regional bank with a significant commercial real estate lending book
trend.metric: $135 million Q3 2026 provision for credit losses, up from $120 million in Q2 2026 and $125 million in Q3 2025
trend.summary: M&T Bank Corporation reported a $135 million provision for credit losses for the third quarter of 2026, up from $120 million in the second quarter of 2026 and $125 million in the third quarter of 2025, according to the bank's October 16, 2026 earnings release.
trend.significance: A rising provision for credit losses at a major regional CRE lender is an early signal that more loan workouts, modifications, and eventual foreclosure or receivership actions are moving through the pipeline, since banks typically build reserves ahead of recognizing actual charge-offs. Commercial property owners and borrowers with loans at regional banks should expect closer lender scrutiny at upcoming maturities and covenant tests as reserve-building continues.
